race.comment: RADIANT LIGHT (2) led and won well two back before a 2L defeat last time out on the quick turnaround. He's a track and trip winner in the past and the claim of Riordan comes in handy. Should be handy from the outset and can put his best foot forward. SIMPLY ROYALTY (6) flew home to win two back before a 1.5L away most recently at this track and trip. He jumped favourite there and his recent figures stand up in this field. Can feature in the finish again. SANDFIRE ROSE (7) comes back in trip today after leading over further and winning last start. Has to be included. BOAB BOY (1) draws better today and can't be left out of calculations.
